question: Which of the following is NOT included in the Indian Food Guide Pyramid for healthy eating?
solution:
The correct answer is __**4) Alcoholic beverages**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Alcoholic beverages** are not included in the Indian Food Guide Pyramid for healthy eating.
 
• The Indian Food Guide Pyramid focuses on a balanced diet including essential nutrients from various food groups.
 
• The food groups in the pyramid include grains, pulses and legumes, vegetables, fruits, milk, meat and products, and fats and sugar
